name: Construction site
desc: Half-built and unguarded after hours - a place people get into that they should not be in.
tags: construction site, steel frame structure, scaffolding, tower crane, bare concrete floor slab, exposed rebar, orange safety netting, stacked breeze blocks, cement mixer, floodlights, plastic sheeting, mud and puddles
prose: an unfinished building of bare concrete slabs and steel framing wrapped in scaffolding and orange netting, a tower crane standing over it and stacked blocks, rebar and floodlights on the churned ground
note: Two different places share this name: the muddy ground-level yard (mixer, blocks, hoarding, ruts) and the exposed upper floors of a frame (open sides, plastic sheeting, long drops). Pick one, because mixing them gives an incoherent middle that is neither. Plastic sheeting and safety netting are the two tags that read as unfinished fastest - without them a bare frame can look derelict instead of new.

evidence_history.method: isolation clean plates (16 frames) survived library reject triage
